title: 의견과 주장: 찬성·반대·근거
objective: You can say whether you are for or against something and give a reason or a pro/con in a short Korean sentence.
summary: Learn 10 intermediate words for agreeing, disagreeing, and giving reasons.

task.title: Use opinion words
task.line: Read each sentence, then choose, fill in, or arrange the word that fits the meaning.

words.meaning: to be in favor of, to support (an idea or plan); used with -에 / -는 데
words.exampleMeaning: I'm in favor of a four-day work week.

words.meaning: to be against, to oppose; used with -을/를 or -에
words.example: 동네 주민들이 공장 건설을 반대하고 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: Local residents are opposing the construction of the factory.

words.meaning: to insist, to claim (strongly say something is true); often -다고 주장하다
words.example: 그 사람은 끝까지 자기가 맞다고 주장했어요.
words.exampleMeaning: He insisted to the end that he was right.

words.meaning: basis, grounds (the reason or evidence behind an opinion)
words.exampleMeaning: What are your grounds for thinking that?

words.meaning: to agree (with someone's words or opinion); used with -에
words.exampleMeaning: I completely agree with what you said.

words.meaning: to persuade, to convince (someone to do or accept something)
words.example: 부모님을 설득해서 겨우 유학을 가게 됐어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I persuaded my parents, and I finally got to study abroad.

words.meaning: advantage, strong point; -다는 장점이 있다 = has the advantage that ...
words.example: 이 집은 역에서 가깝다는 장점이 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: This house has the advantage of being close to the station.
The downside is that the rent is a bit high.

words.meaning: on the other hand, whereas; adjective/verb + -(으)ㄴ/는 반면에 shows a contrasting point
words.example: 지하철은 빠른 반면에 사람이 너무 많아요.
words.exampleMeaning: The subway is fast, but on the other hand it's too crowded.

words.meaning: rather, instead (the result is the opposite of what you expected)
words.example: 쉬려고 여행을 갔는데 오히려 더 피곤해졌어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I went on a trip to rest, but I actually got even more tired.

exercises: Choose 찬성해요 or 반대해요: ① 저는 담배 가격을 올리는 데 ____. 사람들 건강에 좋으니까요. ② 저는 학교에서 휴대폰을 금지하는 것에 ____. 급할 때 연락할 수 없잖아요.
Fill in the blank with 장점 or 단점: ① 혼자 살면 자유롭다는 ____이 있어요. ② 하지만 아플 때 도와줄 사람이 없다는 게 ____이에요.
Fill in the blank with 오히려 or 반면에: ① 이 운동화는 가벼운 ____ 좀 불편해요. ② 감기약을 먹었는데 ____ 더 아파요.
Fill in the blank with the right form of 주장하다, 동의하다, or 설득하다: ① 그 회사는 제품에 문제가 없다고 ____. ② 저도 그 의견에 ____. ③ 친구를 ____ 같이 운동을 시작했어요.
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 근거가 / 주장에는 / 그 / 없어요
answers: ① 주장해요 (주장했어요) ② 동의해요 ③ 설득해서
